description: MUST-FAIL: duplicate key where one value is null. Both "a" members are present; the first has value null and the second has value "v". Absent-field normalization (jcs-n step 1) would remove the null-valued member, but duplicate detection MUST happen before normalization so the duplicate is not silently resolved away.
spec_note: An implementation that normalizes before checking duplicates would remove the null "a" and proceed with {"a":"v"} — incorrectly accepting input that a correct implementation must reject. Duplicate detection is unconditional on the value of the duplicated member.
